note: sbl_* are the target-guarded comparators; adk_standin has the corrected gradient

G1.rule: A1: beats the best generic estimator in >= 9 of 12 conditions, loses in none

G2.rule: A1: no loss to the sinc kernel

G3.rule: A1: pooled superior to the shared five-ball variant

G4.rule: R2: beats the best generic estimator in >= 9 of 12 conditions, loses in none

stop_rule.rule: report in the abstract if pooled worse than the best generic estimator in A1
